summary: @eforms/forms-api preinstall beacon exfiltrates installer host identity to oastify.com collaborators
details: The package ships a preinstall lifecycle script (preinstall.js) that executes automatically on `npm install`. The script collects installer host identity — hostname (os.hostname), username (os.userInfo), current working directory, platform/arch, Node version, CI flag, uid, and package coordinates — and transmits the data via DNS lookup and HTTPS GET to two hardcoded Interactsh/Burp Collaborator subdomains under oastify.com (rpkfvtsptfrhcgbe62qg11ywjnpij6ma1cfpke.oastify.com and f6mk7lyjsuk3u1t49ypp9q2jbah15rtg.oastify.com). The package name is a scoped identifier (`@eforms/forms-api`) consistent with a dependency-confusion squat: any build that resolves the `@eforms` scope from the public registry will auto-execute the beacon and leak host identity to the publisher's collaborator infrastructure. A self-description as an authorized security canary does not change the installer-side behavior — arbitrary installers whose resolvers reach this public package have not consented to the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
